summary: Build practical HR safety skills with ISO 45001, risk assessment, incident follow-up, and reporting tools. Enrol in this 5-day course.
lede: Health and Safety Management for HR Professionals shows you how to embed hazard identification, risk controls, incident response, and safety training into HR policies and people processes. You will learn to map workplace risks, clarify safety responsibilities, and support compliance reporting with practical tools such as risk registers, assessment matrices, and incident investigation methods. The course helps you turn scattered safety knowledge into usable HR outputs, including training needs analyses, safety communication plans, action plans, and simple dashboards. It also introduces digital inspection tools, automated reporting workflows, and AI-assisted safety analytics at a practical awareness level, helping you respond clearly to leadership reviews, audits, and incident follow-up.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for HR professionals who coordinate workplace safety responsibilities, document employee training, and support compliance reporting across the organization.
prerequisites: Participants should have working experience in HR, employee relations, learning and development, or compliance-related coordination. No technical safety qualification is required, but familiarity with workplace policies, training records, and basic reporting will help you apply the exercises quickly. A laptop is recommended for working with templates, dashboards, and exercise files.
